name: Tiruvannamalai

queries.query: Tiruvannamalai cadastral parcel map official Tamil Nadu land records GIS survey map
queries.result: First-party results identified the Tiruvannamalai district administration's scanned town-correlation route, Tamil Nadu TNGIS, the TamilNilam Geo-Info land-record map service, and the official Tamil Nadu land-record service description. No safe anonymous city-bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was obtained.

queries.result: Tamil-language discovery returned the same official Tamil Nadu land-record/GIS routes and district survey-office evidence. The public TamilNilam route was not available as a usable parcel geometry response in this attempt.

officialSources.operator: Tiruvannamalai District Administration / Assistant Director of Survey
officialSources.observation: The official district page directs users to tnlandsurvey.tn.gov.in/index.php/Scanned and identifies the Assistant Director of Survey at the Collectorate in Tiruvannamalai, with a district office contact. This is local survey-office/custodian evidence, but the linked route did not produce parcel geometry in this attempt.

officialSources.operator: Tamil Nadu Department of Survey and Settlement / TNeGA
officialSources.observation: The indexed first-party TamilNilam Geo-Info route exposes District, Taluk, Village and Survey/Subdivision navigation and FMB Sketch functionality. Search indexing showed a live example for Thiruvannamalai district, but no city-targeted safe parcel geometry response was retrieved.

officialSources.operator: Tamil Nadu Geographical Information System / TNeGA
officialSources.observation: Official TNGIS application directory lists Tiruvannamalai among supported districts and states that the portal data are informational and subject to source-agency ownership and maintenance. It is a state GIS lead, not proof of an open cadastral feature endpoint.
General state-government host identified during discovery; no direct city parcel feature service was established from it.
